confusion_matrix.description: Gate confusion matrix on corrupted tasks only (n=47). Positive class = BLOCK (gate decides handoff is bad).

interpretation.TP: 22 corrupted handoffs correctly blocked — gate caught the corruption
interpretation.FP: 18 corrupted handoffs incorrectly passed — gate missed the corruption but agent happened to succeed anyway OR gate was wrong
interpretation.FN: 4 corrupted handoffs blocked but agent still failed after fallback — unrecoverable
interpretation.TN: 3 corrupted handoffs correctly passed — gate rightly let these through
